game_concept: A speed quiz set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Branching Tale: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Make story choices that run different if/elif branches toward different endings. Each round, a new ship ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the story_trust value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of ship ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Branching Tale
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Branching Tale' (Week 3 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Harbor Docks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how story_trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Harbor Docks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 26 seconds.
